targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.ticket_id) AS tickets
FROM grafana_staff_activity a
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(a.created_at)
  AND a.staff_user_id IN ($staff)
  AND a.ticket_type IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(a.server, 'none') IN ($server)
  AND (
    '$involvement' = 'all'
    OR ('$involvement' = 'first_responder' AND a.is_first_responder = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'closer' AND a.is_closer = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'claimer' AND a.is_claimer = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'stale' AND a.is_stale_pickup = 1)
  )

SELECT AVG(a.handle_after_pickup_seconds) AS avg_handle_after_pickup
FROM grafana_staff_activity a
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(a.created_at)
  AND a.handle_after_pickup_seconds IS NOT NULL
  AND a.staff_user_id IN ($staff)
  AND a.ticket_type IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(a.server, 'none') IN ($server)
  AND (
    '$involvement' = 'all'
    OR ('$involvement' = 'first_responder' AND a.is_first_responder = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'closer' AND a.is_closer = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'claimer' AND a.is_claimer = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'stale' AND a.is_stale_pickup = 1)
  )

SELECT SUM(a.message_count) AS messages
FROM grafana_staff_activity a
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(a.created_at)
  AND a.staff_user_id IN ($staff)
  AND a.ticket_type IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(a.server, 'none') IN ($server)
  AND (
    '$involvement' = 'all'
    OR ('$involvement' = 'first_responder' AND a.is_first_responder = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'closer' AND a.is_closer = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'claimer' AND a.is_claimer = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'stale' AND a.is_stale_pickup = 1)
  )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.is_stale_pickup = 1 THEN a.ticket_id END) AS stale_pickups
FROM grafana_staff_activity a
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(a.created_at)
  AND a.staff_user_id IN ($staff)
  AND a.ticket_type IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(a.server, 'none') IN ($server)
  AND (
    '$involvement' = 'all'
    OR ('$involvement' = 'first_responder' AND a.is_first_responder = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'closer' AND a.is_closer = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'claimer' AND a.is_claimer = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'stale' AND a.is_stale_pickup = 1)
  )

SELECT
  a.ticket_id,
  a.ticket_type,
  IFNULL(a.server, 'none') AS server,
  tm.opener_name,
  FROM_UNIXTIME(a.created_at) AS opened_at,
  FROM_UNIXTIME(a.first_message_at) AS their_first_message,
  FROM_UNIXTIME(a.close_time) AS closed_at,
  tm.close_user,
  tm.close_type,
  tm.close_reason,
  a.queue_wait_seconds,
  a.handle_after_pickup_seconds,
  a.age_at_engagement_seconds,
  a.message_count,
  a.is_first_responder,
  a.is_closer,
  a.is_claimer,
  a.is_stale_pickup,
  CASE WHEN tm.transcript_url IS NULL OR tm.transcript_url = '' THEN NULL ELSE 'Open' END AS transcript,
  tm.transcript_url
FROM grafana_staff_activity a
INNER JOIN grafana_ticket_metrics tm ON tm.ticket_id = a.ticket_id
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(a.created_at)
  AND a.staff_user_id IN ($staff)
  AND a.ticket_type IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(a.server, 'none') IN ($server)
  AND (
    '$involvement' = 'all'
    OR ('$involvement' = 'first_responder' AND a.is_first_responder = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'closer' AND a.is_closer = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'claimer' AND a.is_claimer = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'stale' AND a.is_stale_pickup = 1)
  )
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
LIMIT 2000
